title.narrative: Promoting Media Freedom and Access to Quality Information in Guinea Bissau

description.narrative: The overall goal is to have journalists and other media workers in Guinea-Bissau safe and secure, and a professionalized media that promotes human rights, counters trends of extremist radicalisation, and allows citizens access to quality information. The action will contribute to progress towards the realization of SDGs, in particular SDG 16, which is to promote peaceful and inclusive societies, provide access to justice for all and build responsible institutions.
